instructions: Test writing rules for PHPUnit and Shopware conventions. Three tools: get_rules retrieves full rule content — pass ids for specific rules, or filter parameters (group, test_type, test_category, scope, enforce, scoped_review, review_unit), where test_type alone returns that test type's composed catalog. build_rule_package renders a catalog to a file in plugin storage and returns its path, for handing a whole catalog to review agents instead of fetching rules per agent. assert_surviving_tests reports what a test class contains once a set of deletions is applied — pass test_path and deleted_methods to get back {test_path, total, deleted, surviving, status}.
